# OpenZilo

> OpenZilo is a Python 3.10+ SDK and CLI for compatible BLE rings. This index points coding agents to the repository's maintained documentation. The SDK API is the `openzilo` package and its `__all__` list.

Documentation target: SDK v0.6.1. Device instructions cover firmware `V2.001.0002.0000`; the SDK uses protocol v4. Firmware and SDK versions evolve independently. Hardware dependent behavior must be checked on the target device.

The [OpenZilo website](https://openzilo.com) describes a broader platform. Do not infer Python PPG APIs or a TypeScript package from its product concepts; use this repository's public API guide and `openzilo.__all__` for implemented SDK features.

## Source and examples

- [CLI guide (简体中文)](docs/cli.zh-CN.md): default device selection, interactive shell, remote recording, and timed IMU JSONL capture.

- [Public SDK API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ziloai/openzilo/main/src/openzilo/__init__.py): authoritative `__all__`; implementation lives in the package's private submodules.
- [Examples](https://github.com/ziloai/openzilo/tree/main/examples): scan, system information, audio download, and IMU streaming.
- [Live PCM example](examples/live_pcm.py): `open_live_audio_stream()` with async context/iteration, bounded queues, stereo PCM frames, and verified END; optional `pcm` extra uses PyAV.
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ziloai/openzilo/main/SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reporting.
- [MPL-2.0 software license](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ziloai/openzilo/main/LICENSE): current software and documentation license.
- [CERN-OHL-W-2.0 hardware license](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ziloai/openzilo/main/LICENSES/CERN-OHL-W-2.0.txt): hardware design license.

## Agent integration notes

- Install the SDK in your uv project with `uv add git+https://github.com/ziloai/OpenZilo.git`. Start the device terminal with `uvx --from git+https://github.com/ziloai/OpenZilo.git openzilo shell`.
- Import with `import openzilo as sdk` or use `uv run openzilo --help`.
- `sdk.OpenZiloClient` is the connected BLE session; pass it to high-level functions such as `sdk.get_system_info(client)`.
- `ffmpeg` is only required when converting Speex or Opus recordings to WAV.
- For live PCM use `uv add "openzilo[pcm] @ git+https://github.com/ziloai/OpenZilo.git"` and `open_live_audio_stream(client)`; it needs no ffmpeg executable. `output="opus"` uses only base dependencies. Frames are provisional until verified END; context exit aborts unfinished capture.
- `audio-clear` permanently erases device recordings and requires `--yes`.
- Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode use `AGENTS.md`. Claude Code uses `CLAUDE.md` and Gemini CLI uses `GEMINI.md`, both importing `AGENTS.md`. GitHub Copilot uses `.github/copilot-instructions.md` for repository guidance. This `llms.txt` remains a documentation index and is not automatically consumed as a plugin or MCP server.

- [SDK / firmware compatibility](docs/compatibility.zh-CN.md): capability discovery, legacy fallback, SDK version information and feature interface versions.
